input.prompt: Head-mounted snorricam, fisheye lens beneath her chin. She runs through the station, panting. Her chin stays in the same place in frame while the station ceiling sweeps backward and bounces around her with each footstep. Preserve the starting image's angle, face and outfit. One continuous shot. Footsteps and breathing, no speech or music.
